content_sections.heading: How Will ChPA Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Selection by merit; overall grading in the ACRs / APARs not below Very Good Selection is by merit; overall grading in the ACRs / APARs will not be below Very Good

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Copies of ACRs / APARs for the last 5 years (2021-22 to 2025-26) attested on each page by an Officer not below Dy.HoD; No Report Certificate for a pending year Attested photocopies of all certificates and proof of educational qualification, present and past work experience in the respective post and pay scale No objection certificate from the respective Port Certificate by the Head of the Office of the applicant (Annexure-II) Vigilance and Administrative Clearance of the concerned Port as per proforma (Annexure-III) Undertaking that candidature will not be withdrawn if selected; two recent passport size colour photographs in a sealed envelope

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for ChPA Recruitment 2026 Online
content_sections.text: Submit the application through the Online Application Portal (OAP) of the Ministry of Ports, Shipping and Waterways at https://onlinevacancy.shipmin.nic.in. No application other than OAP shall be accepted. Submit the printout of the application uploaded in OAP to your administrative Port for onward forwarding. The Port forwards the application with the listed documents before 24.12.2026. Superscribe 'Application for the post of Secretary, Chennai Port Authority'.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
